svg.title: About Sathish Lella
svg.desc: An animated night scene beside the text. 01 / SUMMARY. Who I am. AI Engineer with Python and software engineering experience developing LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, document intelligence, and secure SaaS workflows. Delivered end-to-end AI and data products spanning requirements, retrieval and API integration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. Built and operate a multi-tenant legal practice platform with permission-aware document analysis. Based in Selangor, Malaysia. In a moonlit clearing a guide in a red cap and grey hoodie waves and says Hi there! from a small cream paper speech bubble, next to a wooden signpost reading Selangor, Malaysia, a lamp post with a swinging paper lantern, a winding dirt path, pine trees and fireflies.
